_comment: Gold set for embedding-retrieval eval. Each item is a SPOKEN-STYLE paraphrase (how a preacher might reference a verse indirectly, NOT a verbatim quote) mapped to the one correct verse. 'ref' must match the exact ref spelling in data/verses-for-embedding.json (Roman-numeral numbered books, 'Psalms', 'Revelation of John'). Extend this file with your own real call-outs — the more it looks like your services, the more the numbers mean. Difficulty is mixed on purpose: some near-quotes, some loose paraphrases, a few deliberately ambiguous.
